audience: A facilities supervisor, venue operator, or worker documenting a quick phone-based sound-exposure observation in the field.
rationale: NoiseDose Field retains the measured noise/dose vocabulary and adds a short work-context carrier, while avoiding a bare Sound Meter category title and avoiding a compliance promise.
